scope.greens_convention: equal-time v^2 normal, signed Delta/(2E) anomalous, degenerate-helicity mean 1/2
scope.continuous_distance_caveat: Noninteger r/a is a Fourier interpolation, not an additional lattice site. Exact integer (Rx,Ry) results are the physically allowed separations of the site-based Hamiltonian.

numerical_methods.paired_solver: repository fsolve with restarts; six independent seeds at Nk=100
numerical_methods.zero_gap_solver: same T=0 equations evaluated at Delta0=DeltaS=0; degenerate Fermi shells have v^2=1/2
numerical_methods.finite_mesh_zero_gap_note: At Nk=100, n=0.75 and 1.25 are not exactly representable by the zero-gap occupation steps. Their residuals are reported, not hidden. Production Nk=400 and Nk=800 fillings are exact.
numerical_methods.stability_boundary: A small residual, positive BdG energies, and reproducibility across seeds establish a stationary numerical branch, not a global free-energy minimum. No global thermodynamic-stability or phase-coexistence calculation is claimed.

spatial_results.interpretation_boundary: The normal-only diagnostic removes f from the Werner formula but retains the paired v_k^2. The normal-reference comparison instead uses the zero-gap state at the same filling. Neither isolates a separately re-solved Delta0-only or DeltaS-only Hamiltonian.
